items.example: Keep the receipt in case you need it.
items.simple: A little paper that shows what you bought and how much it cost.

items.example: I'd like a refund, please.
items.simple: You give back a thing and the shop gives you your money back.

items.example: It's broken. I'd like a refund, please.
items.simple: You ask the shop for your money back. You say it nicely.

items.example: Can I return this jacket?
items.simple: You take a thing back to the shop.

items.example: Can I exchange this for a bigger size?
items.exampleTr: Bunu daha büyük bir bedenle değiştirebilir miyim?
items.simple: You give one thing and get a new one in its place.

items.example: Sorry, do you have the receipt?
items.simple: Someone asks if you have the little paper from the shop.
items.note: İade sırasında kasada en çok duyacağın soru.

items.example: The hairdryer is faulty.
items.simple: Something is broken from the start. It does not work well.

items.example: The box was damaged when it arrived.
items.simple: Something is broken or hurt. It is not nice anymore.

items.example: I bought this yesterday, but it doesn't work.
items.simple: You push the button, but nothing happens. It is broken.

items.example: Excuse me, there's a problem with this.
items.exampleTr: Affedersiniz, bununla ilgili bir sorun var.
items.simple: Something is not good or not right. You tell the shop.

items.example: These trousers don't fit me.
items.simple: Clothes are the right size for your body.

items.example: I love it, but it doesn't fit.
items.simple: Clothes are too big or too small. They are not right for you.

items.example: Can I try this on?
items.simple: You put on clothes to see if they are the right size.

items.example: I'm going to take this back to the shop.
items.simple: You carry a thing back to the shop.

items.en: Do you have a smaller size?
items.tr: Daha küçük bir bedeni var mı?
items.example: Do you have a smaller size in blue?
items.exampleTr: Mavide daha küçük bir beden var mı?
items.simple: You ask for a size that is less big.

items.example: Sorry, that colour is out of stock.
items.simple: The shop has none left. All are gone.

items.example: Is there a discount for students?
items.simple: A smaller price. You pay less money.

items.example: Is this jacket on sale?
items.simple: You ask if the price is lower now.

items.example: These shoes were a real bargain.
items.simple: You buy something very good for very little money.

items.example: It still has a two-year warranty.
items.simple: A promise from the shop that they fix it if it breaks.

items.example: One of the buttons is missing.
items.simple: Something is gone. It is not here, and you need it.

items.example: I want to complain about the service.
items.simple: You say something is not good. You tell someone you are not happy.

items.en: I'd like to speak to the manager.
items.example: Excuse me, I'd like to speak to the manager.
items.simple: You ask to talk to the big boss of the shop.
